welcome-sub: Gedhi Rekusimudzira Africa Kuburikidza nePi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Mukupemberera Zuva reAfrica re25, Chirongwa ichi chePi Pioneers Training chatangwa)
memorial-text:
Iyi Dzidzo Hub yakatsaurirwa hanzvadzi yangu huru inodiwa Christina Muzheki Manjengwa akazorora pa 8 Nyamavhuvhu 2026 tikamuchengetedza musi wa 11 Nyamavhuvhu 2026 rinova zuva reku zorora reku rangarira varwi ve rusununguko mu Zimbabwe.
Rudo rwako, hutungamiri nesimba zvinoramba zvichikurudzira basa redu rekusimudzira Africa.
Nekusingaperi mumoyo medu. Zorora murugare, Hanzvadzi.
intro-p1: Pi Network imari yedhijitari uye chirongwa chepasi rose chakagadzirirwa kuita kuti cryptocurrency iwanikwe uye ibatsire munhu wese.
intro-p2: Kusiyana nemari dzemadhijitari dzechinyakare dzinoda michina inodhura yemigodhi, Pi Network inobvumira vanhuwo zvavo kutora chikamu zvakananga kubva kumafoni avo.
intro-list:
• Vaka hupfumi hwedhijitari hunosanganisira munhu wese pasina mabhanga
  • Simudzira vanhuwo zvavo pasi rose nekuchera panhare
  • Wedzera kushandiswa chaiko kuburikidza nezvishandiso neDApps
  • Tsigira kutengeserana kwemunhu nemunhu uye kuderedza mari
  • Yakagadzirwa naStanford PhDs - Dr. Nicolas Kokkalis na Dr. Chengdiao Fan
  • Vanopfuura Mamirioni makumi matanhatu eMapiyona pasi rose
ch1-p2: Danho 2: Nyoresa neFacebook kana Foni → Isa kodhi: CHIGALEX1 → Wana mubairo we1 Pi
ch1-p3: Kuchera Kwemazuva Ose: Dzoka maawa makumi maviri nemana oga oga wobaya bhatani remheni kuti urambe uchichera.
ch1-list2:
• Usashandise zita remanyepo - rinofanira kuenderana neID yeKYC
  • Usagadzira maakaundi akawanda - munhu mumwe akaundi imwe
  • Isa alarm yekuchera maawa 24 oga oga kuti uchengete mwero
  • Joinha denderedzwa rekuchengetedza mushure memazuva matatu nevanhu 5 vaunovimba navo
ch1-list:
• Gadzira chikwama chePi zvakachengeteka
  • Pedzisa 2FA
  • Pedzisa KYC
  • Gadzirira kutama kweMainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Kuchengetedzeka kwechikwama: Usambofa wakagovana mazwi ako makumi maviri nemana epassphrase! Chikwata chePi Core hachizombokumbira!
ch2-p1: Chikwama chako chePi ibhangi rako muPi Ecosystem. Inobata mari dzako dzePi zvakachengeteka pa blockchain.
ch2-p2: Maitiro ekugadzira: Vhura Pi Browser → Wallet → Gadzira Wallet → KOPIYA mazwi ako makumi maviri nemana → Chengeta pasina internet munzvimbo mbiri dzakachengeteka.
ch2-p3: Kugamuchira Pi: Govera kero yako yeruzhinji (inotanga na G...). Kutumira Pi: Namatira kero yeari kugamuchira, isa huwandu, simbisa.
ch2-list:
• Nyora passphrase pabepa, kwete screenshot
  • Chengeta munzvimbo mbiri dzakasiyana dzakachengeteka (kwete foni chete)
  • Edza ne1 Pi usati watumira huwandu hukuru
  • Tarisa mavara mana ekutanga ne mana ekupedzisira ekero nguva dzose
ch2a-p1: Zvinobatsira: Tanga nehuwandu hudiki hwekuyedza (1 Pi). Simbisa kuti mavara mana ekutanga ne mana ekupedzisira ekero anofananidzana. Usambofa wakaisa passphrase yako pane chero webhusaiti!
ch2a-p2: Chiitiko Chepamoyo: Mukudzidziswa uku, tichaita kuratidzira kwemoyo kwekutumira 1 Pi kune mumwe piyona kuvaka chivimbo. Rangarira: Kutengeserana kweBlockchain hakuchinjiki!
ch3-p1: Pi Browser yakaita seGoogle Play Store yePi. DApps zvikumbwa zvakagoverwa zvekushandisa chaiko — kutenga, dzidzo, mitambo, masevhisi ese achishandisa Pi.
ch3-list:
• Pi Chain Mall (PCM) - Chitoro chikuru chePi
  • WorkforcePool - Mabasa eMapiyona
  • CareForPi - Rutsigiro rwehutano
  • Chigalex1 Hub - Dzidzo (Iyi App)
  • Uye anopfuura 100 mamwe mashandisirwo
ch4-p1: Tsvaga mabhizinesi anogamuchira Pi pasirese pa mapofpi.com. Nyoresa bhizinesi rako pachako wotanga kugamuchira Pi yezvinhu nemasevhisi.
ch4-p2: Maitiro Ekunyoresa Bhizinesi Rako: Enda kumapofpi.com → Batanidza nePi Wallet → Wedzera Bhizinesi → Wedzera mapikicha, nzvimbo, zvigadzirwa → Vatengi vachakuwana! Aya ndiwo maitiro Africa ichatungamira mukugamuchirwa kwePi.
ch5-p1: Global Consensus Value (GCV) inokurudzira kushandiswa chaiko. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Kukosha uku kunovakwa nemapiyona anoshandisa Pi mukutengeserana chaiko, kwete nemutengo wekuchinjana.
ch5-p2: Zvinoreva GCV: GCV hausi mutengo wekuchinjana. Isangano rekuchengetedza kukosha kwePi nekushandisa Pi pamusoro-soro mukubvumirana kwedu pachedu. Patinoshandisa Pi yezvinhu chaizvo paGCV, tinogadzira kudiwa nekushandiswa. Uku ndiko kusimudzira hupfumi hweAfrica.
ch6-p1: Dzidza bhuku raDoris Yin rekugadzira mashandisirwo uye kukura kweecosystem. Tsvagurudza, dzidza, uye dzidzisa vamwe — aya ndiwo maitiro atinosimudzira Africa.
ch6-p2: Basa Rako seAfrica Pioneer: Dzidza → Dzidzira → Dzidzisa vanhu 2 → Vaviri ivavo vanodzidzisa 2 vamwe. Aya ndiwo maitiro atinosvika paMamirioni 1 evaAfrica vakadzidza! Dhawunirodha Whitepaper, verenga, uye govera ruzivo mazuva ose.
final-msg: Africa ine mukana wekuva imwe yematunhu akasimba mukushandisa kunoshanda mukati mePi Ecosystem. Pamwe Tinovaka. Pamwe Tinodzidzisa. Pamwe Tinosimudzira Africa Kuburikidza nePi.
